title: The first FUN AI-native game has arrived on Steam's shores!
author: MakeEmMayhem
selftext:
Hello everyone! I'm Jack from Own It Studio. We are a small indie game team that is passionate about pushing the boundaries of gaming with AI. 

  
Make’Em Mayhem blends autobattler and roguelike elements where every run is a deadly spectacle. Thrown into the King’s Royal Cup, you must summon heroes across the multiverse. Gamble, wager in the black market, hunt prisoners, and survive brutal trials. Win the Cup to find the truth of the mayhem. 

Try it here: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4424310/MakeEm\_Mayhem/?utm\_campaign=pv](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4424310/MakeEm_Mayhem/?utm_campaign=pv) 

**Wishlist on Steam, coming to you in August 2026**

replies.author: MakeEmMayhem
replies.body: mobile version is in the works, but we will launch first on PC! you can try out the game demo for free right now on Steam. we'll post updates about the game so wishlist us and be the first to know when it comes to mobile users 😃
